sara (Head of Rev): Short thread: before we flip price-sheet v3 for the A/B, legal/accounting want confirmation on vendor pass-throughs and sign-off flow for credits >$250. Also need a single point owner for vendor SKU mapping.

aj (Billing): I can own SKU mapping. Plan: mark vendor_pass_through SKUs with `vendor_id` and prefix `VEND-`. Exclusions applied only to experiment metrics, not to invoices.

omar (Vendor Ops): I'll produce the initial vendor SKU list by EOD. Note: some promos are applied as negative subscriptions, not vendor lines. Need to flag those separately.

lena (Sales Ops): We'll tag negotiated negative lines in the cohort CSV as `contract_credit` so billing won't treat them as vendor credits. Uploading sample now.

mike (Accounting): For credits >$250, we require manager approval and an audit row in the CSV with `approver_email` and `reason`. Can billing tooling enforce that?

aj (Billing): Yes, backfill job will create a `reconciliation_queue.csv`. Any credit >$250 will be marked `requires_approval:true` and won't be auto-applied. It will create a ticket in `#billing-recon`.

nora (Support): We'll prep a KB line clarifying that vendor promo adjustments may appear as separate line items and that negotiated credits are handled differently. Posting draft shortly.

sara (Head of Rev): OK owner map: aj = SKU mapping + backfill behavior, omar = vendor SKU list, mike = approval policy. Final request: can we set an experiment metric that excludes vendor SKUs but still reports gross vs net per account? DS needs both views.

aj (Billing): Yes will emit `billing.metrics.gross` and `billing.metrics.net_excluding_vendor` per account daily.

omar (Vendor Ops): Vendor SKU list uploaded: https://drive.internal/redwood/finance/vendor_skus_2029.csv. Please review and flag false positives.

mike (Accounting): Approved workflow. I'll be on the approval rotation for this week. Please ensure tickets include CSV export for audit.

ops-bot: Reminder: runbook section `billing/vendor-skus.md` created by aj.

sara (Head of Rev): Great. Last ask: post any blockers here by tomorrow 08:00 PT. If none, proceed with planned canary. :white_check_mark:
